_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil has produced 0 directional moves in 72 windows and 0/10 analyst calls — HOLD with conviction is the skilled call until a breaker emerges (funding <0.003% + CVD_pct_30d >40 + VIX <12 confirms upside; VIX >18 + DXY >101 + negative funding confirms downside).
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both place current phase at Denial and see a coil, but analyst explicitly rejects the pattern-match optimism the narrative leans on; analyst forward calls Disbelief with HOLD direction while narrative implies upward resolution without naming a phase.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding drops below 0.003% with CVD_pct_30d breaking above 40 and VIX falling below 12 — resolves macro uncertainty and confirms bottom analog recovery thesis
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 18 with DXY breaking 101 and BTC funding turning negative — confirms divergent macro factors are dominant and threatens phase drop to Anxiety or Panic
